title: Red Sand
body:
Description

Red Sand is a common ore found on the shores of the Oke Desert on Ferwater Island, and can only spawn in Red Sandstone nodes found there. The ore is almost the exact same as normal Sand, but with a redder tint in all three of its forms, hence its name. When forged it becomes Red Tinted Glass, however it cannot be dyed to a different color.

Trivia

  • As of 1.62.2, the Red Sand ore name is displayed as 'RedSand' in-game.
